How It Works

SIGNAL-IQ uses real-time camera/IoT vehicle counts fed into a reinforcement-learning optimizer with a Webster's formula baseline. The model continuously learns from traffic patterns and adjusts phase timings to minimize aggregate delay across all approaches.

Why It Matters

Impact & Scalability

Citizen Benefit

Reduced waiting time at intersections means less frustration, fewer accidents, and a better daily commute for millions.

Municipal Benefit

Data-driven traffic planning enables smarter infrastructure investment and real-time operational oversight for city authorities.

Environmental Benefit

Less idling at red lights directly cuts CO₂ emissions and fuel waste — a measurable step toward cleaner urban air quality.

Scalability

Works with existing CCTV cameras and signal controllers — no new hardware needed. Deploy at one intersection or city-wide.

What's Next

Future Roadmap

Phase 1 — Pilot

Deploy at 2–3 intersections with existing camera feeds. Validate adaptive model vs fixed-time baseline. Collect real-world performance data.

Q1 2027

Phase 2 — City-Wide Integration

Integrate with existing traffic control infrastructure (SCATS/SCOOT). Central dashboard for municipal operators. Multi-intersection coordination.

Q3 2027

Phase 3 — Predictive Intelligence

Pre-adjust signals using event calendars, weather data, and accident reports. Festival/rain/construction awareness. Full autonomous operation.
